dedupe_keys.name: smart building system sensor data sutardja dai hall uc berkeley kaggle

description: This Kaggle dataset holds 255 sensor time series from 51 rooms on four floors of Sutardja Dai Hall at UC Berkeley, collected over about a week from Friday 23 August to Saturday 31 August 2013, uploaded by Ranak Roy Chowdhury. Each room has five measurements: CO2 concentration, air humidity, temperature, luminosity and passive infrared (PIR) motion, with PIR sampled every 10 seconds and the others every 5 seconds; each file holds Unix timestamps and readings. About 6 per cent of PIR readings are non-zero, marking occupied periods. The uploader suggests uses in IoT, sensor fusion and time-series classification, regression and clustering. Coverage: one campus office and laboratory building. Access: free download of about 540 MB with a Kaggle account. Licence: not stated; Kaggle lists it as unknown. Caveats: a short one-week window and a secondary upload whose original source and terms are not documented on the page. Simulation uses: occupancy detection from environmental sensors and testing HVAC control or anomaly detection methods. Related records: the TODOS thermal occupancy dataset and the Mortar Brick testbed.
